what: Create Sketch on the top face of a block with a modelled thread and rounded corners, then a boss from it
method: ISO 68-1 basic profile: H = P sqrt3/2, basic depth 5H/8. External groove (the space between teeth): a trapezoid P/4 wide at the root radius d/2 - 5H/8, widening by 2 tan30 per unit of radius to 7P/8 at d/2. Internal groove: P/8 wide at the major radius d/2, widening to 3P/4 at the minor radius, cut only where there is material (r >= hole radius). Pappus: volume per turn = 2 pi A rc (A the trapezoid area, rc its centroid radius from the axis); a helical sweep of L/P turns removes exactly (L/P) x that, where each end of the thread is a free end or lies inside material. Box 20^3, a D5 hole 20 deep (rho=2.5), M6 (P=1) over the whole 20 mm (20 turns, both ends free), the four vertical edges rounded R2 (68.6726), then a sketch on the top face with a 4x4 rectangle at least 4 mm from the hole centre, extruded 5 mm and joined: +80. V = 8000 - 68.6726 - pi 2.5^2 20 - 20 x 3.49832 + 80 = 7548.6619 mm3. Create Sketch on that face was refused ('its history can't tell it apart from other faces'). Tolerance 1%: a modelled thread is a faceted helical solid (radial chord error up to 1% of the pitch on every wall, i.e. a volume deficit of about 4/3 x sag/R).
